subject: ddl: change finishedWritingNeedImport to importStarted (#53643)
summary: Renames and adjusts the ingest add-index recovery gate to treat import as started once engines are closed (`openedEngine == nil`), preventing re-running ingest backfill after `FinishImport` has already begun/completed (e.g. retryable `FinishImport` errors). Also updates a real TiKV ingest test to disable dist-task for the intended local-ingest coverage.
